## Out of scope
- Delivery-transaction integration (P0.09), gate overlay mechanics (P0.10), skill edits (P0.03), editor/UI rendering.

## Cross-cutting invariants
- Sidecar authoritative where md+json both exist; mismatch = failure (REQ-SPEC-12).
- Files are the only inter-phase interface — serializers exist so gate edits reach files (§12.10).

## Design decisions
- Parsers accept {json, markdown?}; validate json via P0.02 zod schema (authoritative); if markdown given AND a structured md twin exists (the write-back trio), parse md → deep-equal vs json, mismatch=failed. Return {parseStatus:'ok', value, ...rows} | {parseStatus:'failed', errors}.
- Read-only sidecars (findings, claim_ledger, rubric) have parsers only (no serializer/md twin — their md is prose; no gate write-back). Write-back trio (response_ledger, structure_plan, cut_list) have serializer + md parser → round-trip.
- Markdown format: markdown scaffold (headings + per-row sections + `- **Label:** <JSON-encoded leaf>` field lines; arrays as ordered/bulleted JSON-encoded items; anchor as inline JSON on one field line). Genuinely structural inverse, lossless. Shared render/parse helpers guarantee inverse.
- claim_sources (AC4): flatten claim.sources[] → rows {claimOrdinal, ordinal(index), url, normalizedUrl, accessedAt, stance, note?}. verdictDeterminingStance(verdict): verified/substantially_accurate/verified_against_user_source→supports; contradicted→contradicts; misleading_in_context→contextualizes; unsupported/unverifiable→null. Parser enforces: if sources present + determining stance has a source + claim.url present → claim.url === that source.url, else failed.
- protocols_version: computeProtocolsVersion(files:Record<path,content>) pure sha256 over the trio (skills/**, manifests/**, parsers/**, serializers/**). collectTrioFiles(root) does fs walk. Exported PROTOCOLS_VERSION = base '0.4.0' + '+' + 12-hex digest, frozen; self-check test asserts it == recompute(collectTrioFiles(root)) so undeclared trio drift → red (bump via scripts/compute-protocols-version.mjs --write). iff proven by unit tests over synthetic maps.
- Contract test primary manifest per skill: editorial-review→review, respond-to-review→revise, bootstrap-persona→profile_voice. Phase-set union across ALL manifests per skill == SKILL heading phase-number set. fact_check '00-claim-inventory.md' is a scope-variant intermediate (not in SKILL, not in F11) → artifact-appearance checked on primary manifests only.
- Add optOutFlag?:string to private PhaseManifest type (superset; stub unaffected). Set on: review verification/discourse/second_read; revise research/gap_analysis; profile+refresh calibration → 'calibration'.
- Golden fixtures live in packages/protocols/fixtures/<project>/ (private pkg owns parser/serializer goldens, F10); derived from real ~/agent-discourse dossiers where they exist, hand-authored plausible twins (documented) where the artifact doesn't exist upstream (cut-list — cut_to_length is a P1 workflow).
